topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: Rain never stops in this town. Found out my partner's been typing away on a secret novel, me in every line. Thought we had an open book between us, but even in the quietest corners, shadows play tricks. Been rereading the parts they showed me, the way they twisted the light. Buildings loom, but it's the spaces between that get you, the places where the truth hides. Now I'm left sifting through the pages, wondering where the real story went cold.
